title: Escape Room Live
specs: Four immersive themed escape rooms including wizard, paranormal, Sherlock Holmes, and Moriarty themes
Recommended for ages 13 and up; younger children welcome with adult supervision
Games are mostly private but may be shared with other groups if spots are unfilled
includes: Designated area to store small personal items during the game
blurb: Guests play one-hour escape room games where they solve puzzles and mysteries in themed rooms. Games are designed for groups and recommended for ages 13 and up, with younger children welcome. Players arrive 15 minutes early for check-in and store belongings in designated areas during play.
extraNote: Reservations can be canceled up to 48 hours before game for full refund · Games can be rescheduled up to 4 hours before reservation time · Within 4 hours of start time, games are non-refundable and non-transferable
